title: Dilemma
subtitle: He has lain down with dogs, hoping to rise without fleas.

items.text: In the dim cell, low chants rise and fall over and over until it almost feels like a natural phenomenon, like the howling of the wind.

items.speaker: Constable I
items.text: Chief, all the Yao we've arrested are here.
Jail, Ancient Zhu County
A cell door creaks open slowly. The other Yao stop and look out from their cells at the three who enter.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Hmph. This must be the true meaning of being "watched like a hawk."

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You may leave. I will have the victim identify the culprit.

items.speaker: Constable I
items.text: Understood.
The cell is packed with Yao. Afraid, a man presses himself fearfully against Chéng Héguāng.
Chéng grips his blade and tells the man not to be afraid, as he takes the first bold step toward them.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I trust there's no need to introduce myself.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: Of course, Chief Chéng. After all, it took us all quite some effort to sneak past you, hahahahaha.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: Let no one say that you neglected your duties. In fact, you did such a sterling job that not even a fly could buzz through that gate.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: A pity for you that I soar much higher than a fly! Ahahahahahaha!
The Yao all laugh, leading Chéng Héguāng to raise his blade and strike it against the cell door.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Quiet!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Look over them. See if you can identify the one that abducted your family.
Even with the cell door between them, the man feels surrounded by Yao; he dodges fruitlessly left then right as if to avoid their gaze.
He peeks at the jailed Yao from the corner of his eye. But each glance makes him all the more concerned.

items.speaker: County Resident I
items.text: I-I don't see them.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: My, my, should I call you County Magistrate Chéng now? If I recall correctly, it falls outside of the duties of mere constables to interrogate suspects.
Through the bars, a bird-like Yao leans toward Chéng Héguāng.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: Could it be that you are using this opportunity to learn the Method of Longevity for yourself? Haha!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Enough of your twittering, bird. I am investigating this rumor on behalf of the people, not for myself.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Nor is this a formal interrogation. I am within my rights to question any one of you.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: Heh heh. And if I don't tell you a thing, what then, Chief Chéng?

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: Must you really be so harsh on us? Every Yao in Zhu County is scared to death of you.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: But I know that you're not all that cruel-hearted. Could you be persuaded to let us go?
As she speaks, she puts both hands through the bars. One holds a gold bar, the other a charm. She waves them before Chéng Héguāng.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: I can offer you both wealth and health.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Fiend! I will not allow you to deceive me.
Chéng Héguāng pushes her hands aside with the back of his blade. She jumps back, staring at him tensely, then approaches once more.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: You think it deception merely because you believe the Method of Longevity to be a false rumor.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: But what if I tell you, it's true, hm? Take a guess at how old I am.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: There's no need to guess. It is said that Yao can live over a thousand years.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: Whoever told you that knew nothing. Our lives are scarcely longer than our true forms. My own kind live and die within the age of a sparrow. Nothing more.
Surprise flashes in Chéng Héguāng's eyes. He motions for her to continue.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: We only want a little more time in this world, Chief Chéng. Why must you stand in our way?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Then should I simply allow you and your people to kill, steal, and bring chaos?

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: Me and my people?
She is stunned for a moment, then responds with a burst of laughter.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: Hahahaha ... I see.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: You believe the Yao to be evil.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: No, not universally. Yet it is Yao like you who spread these dangerous rumors in the county.
The Yao stops laughing, her neck jerking in as her feathers rise and puff out.
Filled with rage, she storms toward Chéng Héguāng, ignoring the bars.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: It is no rumor, fool! Even if it were, what harm have we ever brought for speaking it alone? All our kind desire is to live!

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: I've done nothing wrong! Release me! Every moment is precious!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You may not have taken part in these abductions, but the rumors you spread surely enticed the ones that did. I will not release you.

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: Fine, continue in your blindness, but the School of Mei will bring justice to us all.
The Yao turns fierce, beating her wings in the cell. Claw marks cover the walls.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: The School of Mei. That's the name of your sect, is it?
Her anger has become an incomprehensible mash of threats and insults. Chéng Héguāng stands between her and the scared man, leading him away.
Study, Yamen
In the Yamen's study, the man sits shaking on a wooden chair.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Calm down. Have some tea.

items.speaker: County Resident I
items.text: Th-Thank you.
He takes the tea, sips a few times, then sets it down.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: No need to worry; our cells are quite unbreakable.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: So, what more do you know of the Yao that abducted your family?

items.speaker: County Resident I
items.text: It was jabbering on about "longevity." That's all I know.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: This rumor is a true menace to society.

items.speaker: County Resident I
items.text: Please, Chief Chéng, please find my father. You're my only hope.
He grabs the front of Chéng Héguāng's clothes as if to kneel. But the chief constable catches him by the arms and lifts him to his feet.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Please, sir. I am merely fulfilling my duty.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I will find the truth. This I swear.

items.speaker: County Resident I
items.text: Thank you.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Rest a while. Best not to overwork yourself.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Guard!

items.speaker: Constable I
items.text: Chief.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Take care of the good man. I must deliver my report on the events at the opera.

items.speaker: Constable I
items.text: Understood.
Chéng Héguāng pats the poor man's shoulder as they walk out.
A breeze follows him past the door and scatters far away.
Hall, Yamen
In the great hall, a report on the case is being given to the gathered court.

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: The female Daoist raised her sword above a woman's head, revealing the latter's true form to be that of a herbaceous entity and shifting her withered leaves into a verdant green.

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: The Daoist then proclaimed the ability to bestow longevity upon any who joined her school. This declaration incited the crowd to a frenzy as they stampeded the stage.

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: Later, the Daoist vanished from the scene together with the herbaceous entity. Several Yao present were detained, and the injured were escorted to the nearest clinic for treatment.

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: In summary, the stampede has been determined to be an unforeseen incident arising from the female Daoist's use of arcane skills.
With the report concluded, the paper is folded once more and then handed over to the county magistrate.

items.speaker: County Magistrate
items.text: "Unforeseen incident"? Your lack of foresight has seen this longevity rumor spread to every corner of the county!

items.speaker: County Magistrate
items.text: Yao are flooding our lands in droves! Never in my life have I received so many reports of missing persons and acts of sedition!

items.speaker: County Magistrate
items.text: Make no mistake. This is the result of your errors!
The magistrate crumples the paper and throws it at the registrar. In response, the man bows even lower.

items.speaker: County Magistrate
items.text: *sigh* We were foolish to put our faith in you.

items.speaker: County Magistrate
items.text: Commander Lì, you are in charge of our defenses. Tell me, how should we proceed?
Lì Huìfēng had been standing nearby; he pauses, considering the details for a moment, before speaking out in a measured tone.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: In these desperate times, I can see only one solution.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: I would divide all constables into two shifts and have them sweep the entire county. We will locate and apprehend all Yao hiding among the populace over the next three days.

items.speaker: County Magistrate
items.text: Very good! Do you hear that? All departments will cooperate with Commander Lì! And if I hear of any misconduct, I will show no mercy!
The others hasten to agree as they bow with clasped hands.
Chéng Héguāng has been wanting to speak. Seeing his chance, he seizes it and steps forward.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Honorable Magistrate, I believe we also ought to consider investigating the School of Mei.
The other clerks sneak sneering glances toward him, like a discolored bean sifted from the pile.

items.speaker: County Magistrate
items.text: And you are? Wait, I believe I recall, Chief Chéng, is it?

items.speaker: County Magistrate
items.text: And this School of Mei? A minor religious sect, yes?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Yes. Please forgive me. After the report was submitted, I discovered a connection between the sect and the animal carcasses found on the streets.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: While in custody, a suspect admitted that the School of Mei was behind the mysterious parade connected to both the rumors and the drained carcasses.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I believe this opera was another part of their scheme. If the Yao are the fruit, the School of Mei is the root.
The others look away and whisper.

items.speaker: Deputy Magistrate
items.text: And who are you to speak? Some upstart boy desperate to clear his family name?

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: That's him alright. Just last month, he was ranting about some thief-catching scheme; the argument could be heard from the streets.

items.speaker: Deputy Magistrate
items.text: Do you remember last year? This boy nigh on knocked the doors down, insisting we include those deserters he caught in our update to the Imperial Court.

items.speaker: Deputy Magistrate
items.text: Hard to believe the magistrate allowed him to leave with his head. It seems he hasn't any sense for his position or his shame.

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: The son of a bandit turncoat. No wonder he barks like a dog, demanding praise for his every deed.

items.speaker: Registrar
items.text: He's fooling himself if he thinks he can wash himself clean of his family's past.
Chéng Héguāng ignores their whispers and stands tall and firm as a noble pine.

items.speaker: County Magistrate
items.text: Commander Lì, thoughts on this matter?
As all else goes quiet, Lì Huìfēng clears his throat and speaks.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Ahem. I hold to what I've said before; the Yao pose a serious danger to the people. Our priority must be to expel them from the county.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: What would you have us do, Your Honor?

items.speaker: County Magistrate
items.text: The matter is handed to Commander Lì. Dismissed.

items.speaker: Constables
items.text: Understood.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: But the School of Mei ...
The others seem prepared to leave, but Chéng Héguāng looks around anxiously, until finding the familiar shape of his commander waiting under the eaves.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Commander Lì!

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Come here, Héguāng.
Lì Huìfēng walks from the hall in long, quick strides, forcing his subordinate to hurry to keep pace.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Are you really so desperate for glory that you forget the chain of command?

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: How do you aim to win trust if you refuse to pay respect to your betters?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I apologize, Commander.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: But this is a promising lead. If we don't act now, we may miss our chance.
Lì Huìfēng turns, his voice sterner than ever.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Do you think you're the only one with a lead on this case?

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: That no one else can do as you have done? Not even those with greater power and resources?

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Is that why you announced your intentions for all to hear? Your heart may be pure, but others have their own designs. If your words reach the wrong ears, do you think they will sit and do nothing about it?
Chéng Héguāng's tongue twists. He had prepared for a scolding, not this.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Commander, you mean ...

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Keep digging, but do not draw any further attention.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: That's all for today. And if your actions are brought to light, I will tell them I denied your request, understood?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Yes, Commander!
He bows deeply, then straightens his posture.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I will learn from your wise words.
